== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[King Dakata]] is the ruler of the [[Seishen Kingdom]], a realm that maintains a castle in the [[Night Wheel Valley]] constructed from raw [[stone]]. He is described as having shaggy hair and a dark, grizzled beard that gives him a bear-like appearance. In combat, he utilizes advanced gray armor, a large [[sword]], and a heavy metal shield featuring a lion's visage. [[Dakata]] leads his kingdom's forces, which include various ranks of warriors such as [[Underlord|Underlords]] and [[Golds]], and he travels via cloudships. He is a proud father to his two sons: the first prince, [[Prince Seishen Kiro|Kiro]], and the second prince, [[Seishen Daji|Daji]]. The King is motivated by a desire to prove his kingdom's worth to [[Fury]] and seeks to gain valuable contribution points. He has demonstrated respect toward the [[Sage]], even kneeling before her after engaging in battle.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The Seishen King possesses shaggy hair and a rough beard colored with black and gray. He is seen equipped with both a [[sword]] and a shield.}}
